title: Samaṇabrāhmaṇā
text: 2. Cha yimāni bhikkhave indriyāni || katamāni cha || || Cakkhundriyaṃ || [pe] || manindriyaṃ || || 3. Ye hi keci bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā imesaṃ channam indriyānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti || na me te bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā-upasampajja viharanti || || 4. Ye hi keci bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā- pajānanti || te kho me bhikkhave- -sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharantīti || ||
